widgets_values: He steadies his posture and lifts his chin, fingers forming a precise triangle that tightens, eases, and tightens again while the wrists rotate a notch and the rings and bracelets shift; the round lenses catch the light and send moving reflections across his cheeks as his eyes blink once and settle forward, the third eye opening wider, centering, and holding. Loose strands of neon hair lift and sweep across his forehead, then fall along the ears; the hoop earrings swing on short arcs and the collar clasp nudges with each breath as the chest rises and lowers. The halo behind his head turns a few degrees and pulses in steady cycles, its spokes extending and retracting as faint marks slide along the ring; stray motes drift outward from the crown and cross the frame in slow lines. The eye within the chest triangle brightens, contracts its pupil, and sends a soft glow that climbs his hands and outlines the fingertips before fading; the robe edges ripple at the shoulders, seams flex along the sleeves, and small highlights travel over the hands and jewelry with every motion.
